name: Asia Metal Industries, Inc.
summary: Asia Metal Industries, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, designs, processes, manufactures, and trades in metal mechanics and parts in China, Malaysia, Thailand, and Taiwan. It offers PP synthetic papers; optics products, including embossing machines, optical film lab coaters, and reflective film coating and compounding machines; gas, electric heating, and hot air PTFE treaters; low temperature co-fired ceramics and multi-layer ceramic capacitors coating machines; and flexible CCL and solar energy products.
